resources.string: You can change it any time in Settings.
Fit any photo to your screen
Open a photo and frame it to the exact resolution of your screen. Retouch it with healing, layers, filters and adjustments, and save it as a copy or replace the original.
In Wallpapers, add folders or photos and filter them with tags. Turn on the live wallpaper and double tap an empty spot on the home screen to change the photo.
A clock that matches each photo
Add the clock widget from Wallpapers and choose its font and colour. In the editor, the phone button shows how the photo will look with the clock.
Choose the language and see the basics again
